WITH transaction_sentiments AS (
  SELECT 
    tr.transreg,
    tr.ordertypedist,
    AVG(sf.shortintrt) as avg_shortintrt,
    AVG(sf.optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt
  FROM transactionrecord tr
  INNER JOIN sentimentandfundamentals sf ON tr.transreg = sf.transref
  GROUP BY tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist
),
baseline_by_ordertype AS (
  SELECT 
    ordertypedist,
    AVG(avg_shortintrt) as baseline_shortintrt
  FROM transaction_sentiments
  WHERE avg_shortintrt IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
)
SELECT 
  ts.transreg,
  ts.ordertypedist,
  ts.avg_shortintrt,
  ts.avg_optvolrt,
  CASE 
    WHEN bb.baseline_shortintrt IS NOT NULL
    THEN ts.avg_shortintrt / bb.baseline_shortintrt
    ELSE NULL
  END as shortintrt_ratio
FROM transaction_sentiments ts
LEFT JOIN baseline_by_ordertype bb ON ts.ordertypedist = bb.ordertypedist
ORDER BY 
  shortintrt_ratio IS NULL,
  shortintrt_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The baseline for each order type is computed as the average of per-transaction short-interest averages, excluding transactions with NULL per-transaction averages. Transactions with all NULL shortintrt values across their sentiment snapshots are omitted from the baseline calculation.
NULL values in shortintrt and optvolrt columns are ignored when computing per-transaction averages (standard SQL AVG() behavior).
